why_not_one_block_off: The corridor is lettered 'AVE. H OR BALL' inside the roadway I measured on both plates, and on both it is the 700/800 hundred-block break of the numbered streets: the block face west of it reads 701 703 ... 723 / 702 704 ... 724 and the face east of it reads 801 803 805 807 / 802 804 806 808, on sheet 23 and on sheet 29 alike. One block WEST is excluded because that corridor is lettered 'AVE. G OR WINNIE' (sheet 23 center 1152.5, sheet 29 center 1135.0, about 1010 px west) and it carries the 600/700 break instead - the 623/624 run is printed on its far side on both plates. One block EAST would be Ave I (Sealy), beyond the 800-block, which is not the face pair measured here. The block column between Ave G and Ave H is continuous across the shared 12TH ST seam with consecutive Galveston block numbers and hundred-block avenue addresses: sheet 23 has block 310 (Sherman Park, 10th-11th, avenue faces 1001-1027 and 1002-1028) and block 311 (Henry Rosenberg Free School, 11th-12th, 1101-1127 and 1102-1128); sheet 29 continues with block 312 (12th-13th, 1201-1227 / 1202-1228) and block 313 (13th-14th, 1301-1321 / 1302-1322). MEASUREMENT: midpoint of the two facing block lines, read off the green native ruler in the band immediately adjacent to the shared 12TH ST seam and averaged over the two crops that show the corridor - sheet 23 faces 2053.2/2266.4 (cand1) and 2051.9/2263.7 (cand3), sheet 29 faces 2039.4/2252.6 (cand1) and 2036.9/2250.1 (cand3). NOTE: neither reported coordinate is a detection candidate - all three candidates on each sheet (23: 728/1751/2774, 29: 726/1746/2767) are mid-block lines near the 20-ft alleys (sheet 23 block 311 alley native 1626.7-1687.0, sheet 29 block 312 alley 1610.0-1671.7), not avenues.
